svg.title: Nacre satellite communications — GEO, MEO, and LEO
svg.desc: Three services connect ground sites and satellites. A geostationary relay serves Polar Clinic VSAT, tracked MEO relays connect Orinthia and Caelum, and an optical LEO mesh connects Orinthia to gateways in Caelum and Ilyndor. The ground inset shows telecom handoffs. Coverage maps compare a fixed GEO beam, overlapping MEO windows, and LEO spot beams.
svg.text: GEO VSAT, MEO backhaul, and meshed low-latency LEO
Logical links and schematic service areas · Basemap adapted from the Synthetic Exercise World atlas

g.inkscape:label: Nacre ground geography and telecom handoffs
g.text: A gateway needs a working terrestrial handoff to carry traffic beyond the satellite link.

svg.text: Route IDs match the guide and Galaxy records.

g.inkscape:label: GEO coverage footprints
g.text: Anchor G1 illuminates the same regional footprint.

g.inkscape:label: MEO coverage footprints
g.text: The A and B beams show successive tracked windows.
Caelum and Orinthia are within both footprints.

g.inkscape:label: LEO coverage footprints
g.text: Spot beams show one exercise snapshot.
Swift L3 relays through the mesh with no ground site shown.
